additional_units.reported_label: changes in RV free wall strain (RVFWS)
additional_units.role_evidence_quote: The primary endpoint of this exploratory substudy was changes in RV free wall strain (RVFWS) across the whole cohort.
additional_units.result_quote: 1 RV dysfunction is associated with progression and prognosis in HF patients, 2 with earlier studies showing that each 1% worsening in RV free wall strain (RVFWS) was independently associated with a 5% increased risk of all-cause mortality.

additional_units.role_evidence_quote: The primary efficacy measure in the exploratory substudy was the between-group difference in the change in RVFWS from baseline to 12-week follow-up.
RVFWS was also stratified into tertiles based on baseline RVFWS.
additional_units.result_quote: patients in the lowest tertile demonstrated a significant improvement with empagliflozin (treatment effect: -2.9% [95% CI: -5.0 to -0.3]; P = .027).

additional_units.role_evidence_quote: Patients were stratified into subgroups based on tertiles of baseline values of RVFWS.

additional_units.reported_label: changes in tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion (TAPSE)
additional_units.reported_instrument: M-mode cursor over the lateral tricuspid annulus
additional_units.role_evidence_quote: Secondary endpoints included changes in tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion (TAPSE) and RV S' velocity.
additional_units.result_quote: Compared to placebo, empagliflozin did not have a significant impact on TAPSE [adjusted treatment effect: -0.06 cm (95% CI: -0.18 to 0.07); P = .78] or RV S' [adjusted treatment effect: -0.006 cm/s (95%: -0.014 to 0.002); P = .14], on the overall population ( Table 3 , Figure 1 ).
